decision: 선택형 지역 안내의 효과를 재기 전에 기존 GA4 계측 연결성을 감사한다
source: BigQuery GA4 daily export, 2026-09-04 through 2026-09-12 KST

assumptions.assumption: GA4 event parameter platform=toss identifies observed Toss webview events, not necessarily first-ever players.
assumptions.rationale: The same device could have played through another platform earlier.
assumptions.validation: Reconcile event-level platform with internal session logs and prior web activity.

assumptions.assumption: beta_A/beta_B markers exclude known testers, but unmarked internal use may remain.
assumptions.rationale: Earlier marker audit found no beta-marked Toss rows.

assumptions.assumption: shown=true records a banner-display request, not proof that a user saw or heard it.
assumptions.rationale: Client logs the requested UI and cue; playback success and attention are not measured.
assumptions.validation: Instrument UI render success and separate sound requested from sound played.

assumptions.assumption: zone_enter cannot be attributed to a recommendation without a shared recommendation ID and target area.
assumptions.rationale: Current score rows have neither field and zone_enter covers only some zones.
assumptions.validation: Add shared recommendation ID to impression, tap, arrival, and first target action.

assumptions.assumption: September 12 is the last complete GA4 daily export in this analysis.
assumptions.rationale: The previous Toss audit excluded September 13 pending its daily export.
assumptions.validation: Recheck export availability before the next gate.
